extDescription.message: Lets your UClone-X clones use tabs in this Chrome, in a tab group you can see.

intro.message: Paste the pairing code from UClone-X Settings ▸ Browser. Clones then open their tabs here, in a "UClone-X" tab group, and Chrome shows a bar while a clone uses a tab. Close that bar to take the tab back.

status_unpaired.message: Not connected yet. Paste the pairing code and press Connect.

status_connected.message: Connected. Your clones can use this Chrome.

status_refused.message: UClone-X did not accept this pairing code. It may have been replaced: copy the code from Settings ▸ Browser again.

status_unreachable.message: UClone-X did not answer. Check that it is running, then copy the code from Settings ▸ Browser again.

notACode.message: That is not a pairing code. Copy the whole code from UClone-X Settings ▸ Browser.
